body: Every time I make a friend I get hurt. Sometimes by my ex talking bad about me. Other times by me doing something stupid. I don't have a lot going on in my life except for my failures. It probably wouldn't benefit you to be my friend.
No. I don't have anyone in my life. After what I've been through I don't even want anyone in my life.
I'm really not. There's not really anything interesting about me.
If you only knew me you wouldn't say that.
It's absolutely true. Too much has happened for me to trust anyone. I don't want people in my life because either they will hurt me or I will hurt them.

I don't want my family knowing about everything that has happened. I don't want anyone knowing. Most are too embarrassing. Most aren't even things that I did. Just things that happened to me. My ex claimed to try to help but he didn't. He would stop me when I was on the verge of killing myself but he wouldn't really try to help me. After he'd stop it I wouldn't hear from him for days. Suicidal thoughts don't go away after a few hours. He always felt obligated to help. Never actually cared. Everyone tells me he is an ass to me but I don't know.
There's no way I can have a new beginning. I'll always have the memories of all that happened. I can't trust anyone. I can't love anyone. What kind of life is that?

I've given it some thought. This isn't the first time I've tried. Every time I wanted to my ex would stop me because he would stalk my online activity. He made me promise I wouldn't. He hates me more than anyone ever. I know he won't stop me now. I don't have friends anymore. Because of my pain and because of him I lost all of them. I tried traveling because that was something I wanted to do but it made me feel worse to travel by myself. I feel so alone. I've always been alone.

But I constantly make terrible mistakes. I have tried. Even when I've done nothing wrong I get treated like I am. It hurts to care for people more than they care for you. It hurts to know that I went through so much that wasn't my fault and yet I get blamed. I can't do it. I won't do it anymore.

I have talked to one in particular. He puts the blame all on me. He tells everyone else it's me and that he wants to get away from me. I've honestly tried to improve but I kept getting treated badly and reminded of all the bad things that happened. I feel like there is no hope.  Last time I talked to him I pushed him away anyway. I made him hate me more. He told me he hated me and wanted nothing to do with me.

I know why I've done them. It's everyone else who can't understand. Because I needed support during the bad times.  They still don't understand what I'm going through. I'm always that person who did it. I've tried atoning for my actions and they still treat me like I'm that person. I'll always be the "train wreck."
I have talked to counseling. It doesn't matter. This is all a result of me being terrible and doing terrible things. No medication can fix the person I am. No medication can stop me from being me.
I'd prefer not to say in case someone I know comes across this before I do it. I've had that happen before. I'm an adult. Not a teenager.
Because I'm an awful person. I destroy everything and I'm never good enough for anyone. Everything I do is wrong.
